extension.summary: Points the weather at where you really are when travelling
extension.description: Reads the trip choice from the StreamPI setup page (/var/lib/streampi/travel.json). On a cruise it follows the ship's live position, in a hotel it uses the city you chose, and at home it leaves the weather on automatic. Never changes the time zone.
extension.news: 1.0.0 - Cruise and hotel; plane to follow.
